subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils 5/7] nfsdctl: register nfsd listeners with rpcbind

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the nfsdctl utility to register NFS and NFSACL listeners with the local rpcbind instead of the kernel. This change addresses a problem where a slow rpcbind could block other NFSD netlink commands due to synchronous calls made by the kernel while holding an internal mutex. The new approach involves sending a flag, reading the reply, and then registering the listeners without holding any locks. The patch also includes support for detecting whether the kernel supports this feature and handles cases where registration fails or is not supported.
